description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of the I18NTranslationValidationAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It sets up test data, mocks dependencies, and tests specific API behaviors such as retrieving translation validation data. The class also includes method stubs for update and delete operations that are marked as not implemented.

classes.name: I18NTranslationValidationAPITest
